contract.command_alphabet: All 8 parallel binary vectors; terminal action also permits all 8.
contract.deadline: After terminal action in each round; no claim of correct plant state immediately after calibration probe.
contract.drift_law: Independent uniform draws from 4 changes, equivalently uniform over 16 fixed oblivious two-round sequences.
contract.goal: Each round's net effect toggles named effect port 0 only.
contract.last_round_increment_only: Scores state_end_2 XOR state_start_2 == e_0; it does not score the final plant state relative to the initial state and is not terminal-memory recovery.
contract.memory: All past returned observations and issued actions may be retained without bound.
contract.plant: Both commands physically XOR-toggle the same plant. No reset is assumed; actual end states are traced.
contract.probe_observation: Entire 3-bit effect vector, not one scalar.
contract.randomization: Independent randomization cannot improve the fixed-prior average optimum, since it is a mixture of deterministic complete policies.
contract.terminal_observation: Main branch returns entire terminal effect vector; separate branch withholds it.
contract.wiring_change: Identity or one effect-port transposition before each round; no changes within a round.

two_probe_repair.extension_to_arbitrary_horizon: Per-round identification and algebraic net-effect correction, with wiring fixed inside each round; proof in NEXT_RESEARCH_PROBE.md.
